source: Attack twice with the Attack action, and one of those attacks may be a cantrip with a casting time of one action.
Song of Defense
A reaction while bladesinging spends a spell slot to reduce damage to you by five times the slot level.
Song of Victory
Add your Intelligence modifier (at least +1) to melee weapon damage while bladesinging.
A wizard of Wildemount who manipulates time itself: initiative, durations and dice.
Chronal Shift

After you or a creature you can see within 30 feet makes an attack roll, ability check or saving throw, a reaction forces a reroll once you see whether it succeeded, and the second roll stands. Twice per long rest.
Temporal Awareness
Add your Intelligence modifier to initiative.
Momentary Stasis

As an action, a Large or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC or is incapacitated with speed 0 until the end of your next turn or until it takes damage; a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once) per long rest.
Arcane Abeyance
Store a spell of 4th level or lower in a bead that anyone can break to cast it; recharges on a short or long rest.
Convergent Future
A reaction dictates the outcome of a roll within 60 feet as a success or a failure, at the cost of a level of exhaustion.
A wizard of Wildemount who bends weight and gravity, crushing, slowing and hurling.
Adjust Density
Halve or double a creature's or object's weight for a minute, changing its speed, carrying capacity and Strength checks.
Gravity Well
Any creature you affect with a spell can be moved 5 feet to a space of your choice.
Violent Attraction

When a creature you can see within 60 feet hits with a weapon attack, a reaction adds 1d10 to its damage; or when a creature within 60 feet takes falling damage, a reaction adds 2d10. A number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum once) per long rest.
Event Horizon

As an action, for a minute (concentration) you emanate a 30-foot field: each hostile creature that starts its turn in it makes a Strength save against your spell save DC, taking 2d10 force damage and having speed 0 until the start of its next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success, after which every foot it moves in the field costs 2 extra feet. Once per long rest, or by expending a spell slot of 3rd level or higher.
A wizard whose spellbook wakes up and starts talking, and whose spells can change their element.
Wizardly Quill
Conjure a magic quill that needs no ink, scribes at speed, and can erase what it wrote.
Awakened Spellbook

Your spellbook gains a mind and becomes your spellcasting focus. When you cast a wizard spell with a slot you can change its damage type to one found in another spell in your book of the slot's level; once per long rest you can cast a ritual spell from the book at its normal casting time rather than adding 10 minutes; and over a short rest your quill can turn a blank book into a new home for its mind.
Manifest Mind

As a bonus action, manifest your spellbook's mind as a Tiny spectral object within 60 feet that sheds dim light in 10 feet, sees in darkness to 60 feet and moves up to 30 feet when you use a bonus action; it ends if it is ever more than 300 feet from you. While it is manifested you can cast a wizard spell from its space a number of times per long rest equal to your proficiency bonus. Manifesting it is free once per long rest, or costs a spell slot of any level.
Master Scrivener

After a long rest you can create a magic scroll of a 1st- or 2nd-level wizard spell from your book with a casting time of an action; it is cast as if one level higher, and it vanishes once cast or when you finish a long rest.
One with the Word

While your spellbook is on your person you have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks. If you take damage while the book's mind is manifested, a reaction dismisses it to prevent all of that damage; then roll 3d6, and spells in your book with a combined level at least that total vanish from it until you finish 1d6 long rests (if there aren't enough, you drop to 0 hit points). Once per long rest.
An artificer who works in tinctures and reagents, healing allies and corroding enemies with thrown concoctions.
Tool Proficiency (Alchemist)
Proficiency with alchemist's supplies.
Experimental Elixir
